market_summary: Pre-market, Wednesday 25 Nov 2026 (as of 08:30 IST). NSE/BSE resume after Tuesday's Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday. Last cash session, Monday 23 Nov: Nifty 50 closed at 25,349.65 (-1.75%) and Sensex at 82,435.99 (-1.77%). The decline was broad: 14 of 16 major sectors fell; banks and financials lost 2.4%-3.3%, metals fell 3.7%, while IT was the relative leader. Reuters' 07:43 IST GIFT Nifty snapshot at 25,738 indicated a positive opening setup, but the overnight risk tone weakened: US indices were mixed on 24 Nov and Asian technology markets fell sharply as the AI rebound faded and renewed US tariff concerns emerged. Provisional cash flows for 23 Nov showed FII/FPI net buying of ₹5,673 crore and DII net selling of ₹2,760 crore. Brent was around $90.80/bbl and Reuters-trader indications put USD/INR's expected open at ₹92.70-92.75 versus Monday's ₹92.91 close. Watch opening breadth, banks/metals, tariff headlines and US GDP/Personal Income and Outlays data due later Wednesday. No portfolio-holdings file was found in the accessible repository search, so the stock list is market-wide rather than holding-prioritised. Facts are source-linked below; bias fields are interpretation only. No guaranteed calls or financial advice.

global_cues.title: GIFT Nifty points to a positive opening indication
global_cues.detail: Reuters recorded GIFT Nifty at 25,738 at 07:43 IST on 25 Nov, versus the Nifty 50's previous cash close of 25,349.65 on 23 Nov. This is a futures snapshot and an opening indication, not a live cash-market quote or a guaranteed opening level.

global_cues.title: Wall Street was mixed as the AI rebound faded
global_cues.detail: On 24 Nov, the S&P 500 fell 0.5% and Nasdaq Composite fell 1.5%, while the Dow gained 0.9% and Russell 2000 rose 0.6%. Nvidia fell 5.9% after surrendering part of Monday's sharp rebound. Interpretation: the tech-led global risk impulse is less supportive than the prior session's rally.

global_cues.title: Asian technology markets sold off sharply
global_cues.detail: Early Wednesday, MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan was down 2.3%; South Korea's KOSPI fell as much as 5.3%, Taiwan's market 5.1% and Japan's Nikkei 225 2.9%. Chip-heavy markets led the decline as the AI rally faded and fresh US tariff concerns hit sentiment.

global_cues.title: US excess-capacity tariff probe includes India
global_cues.detail: Reuters reported on 24 Nov that the US administration was preparing findings from a Section 301 probe covering 16 trading partners, including India, China, Japan, South Korea and the EU. New import duties were expected to be proposed, but country-specific rates and final measures were not yet confirmed. This is a policy risk, not an announced tariff schedule.

global_cues.title: Brent eases as supply-surplus concerns offset Middle East risk
global_cues.detail: Reuters reported Brent at $90.80/bbl, down 0.7%, in its 07:47 IST India-market snapshot. Supply recovery and the prospect of a fourth-quarter surplus are weighing on prices, while vessel incidents near the Strait of Hormuz keep supply-disruption risk elevated. Lower crude is relatively supportive for India's import bill.

global_cues.title: US GDP and October personal-income data are due later Wednesday
global_cues.detail: The US Bureau of Economic Analysis schedules the Q3 2026 GDP second estimate and October 2026 Personal Income and Outlays release for 08:30 ET on 25 Nov. The latter includes the PCE price indexes watched by the Federal Reserve. No release value was available as of this pre-market update.
global_cues.source: US Bureau of Economic Analysis, 2026 release schedule

intraday.headline: Framework agreement with Korea's Woojin targets metro coaches and rail propulsion systems
intraday.what_changed: Verified NSE filing under Regulation 30, also addressed to BSE: Jupiter Wagons executed a framework agreement with Woojin Industrial Systems to pursue Indian rolling-stock opportunities through a consortium and proposed JV. The proposed JV shareholding is 80% Jupiter Wagons and 20% Woojin. The scope includes jointly bidding for metro tenders and manufacturing coaches in India, with technology transfer for propulsion systems, EMUs, train-control systems and related railway products. Jupiter Wagons will lead the consortium, fund JV establishment and operations, and manage local execution. The filing reports no current shareholding in the proposed JV; it does not disclose a committed order value, capital budget or formation date.
intraday.why_it_matters: Interpretation: the agreement could broaden Jupiter Wagons from freight rolling stock into metro coaches and propulsion technology, creating access to a larger tender pipeline. It remains a framework-stage opportunity rather than booked revenue or a confirmed order.
intraday.risk: Jupiter Wagons is responsible for funding the proposed JV's land, plant, machinery and working capital. JV formation, capital requirement, tender wins, technology transfer and execution timing remain uncertain; no earnings or price target is implied.
intraday.source: Jupiter Wagons Limited, NSE/BSE Regulation 30 filing, 23 Nov 2026

intraday.headline: Centum signs exploratory MoU with Pixxel for satellite payload and miniaturised SAR electronics
intraday.what_changed: Verified NSE/BSE Regulation 30 filing dated 24 Nov: Centum entered an MoU with SpacePixxel Technologies to explore joint development of advanced satellite payloads, including miniaturised Synthetic Aperture Radar electronics and related subsystems. The parties also intend to explore technical knowledge exchange and satellite applications. The filing describes an exploratory collaboration and does not disclose an order value, committed revenue, capex or delivery timetable.
intraday.why_it_matters: Interpretation: the collaboration aligns Centum's high-reliability space-electronics capability with Pixxel's Earth-observation satellite systems and could create future payload-development opportunities. It is not a firm purchase order or quantified earnings catalyst.
intraday.risk: The MoU is exploratory; commercial conversion, programme scope, customer funding, pricing and delivery schedules are not disclosed. Avoid treating the announcement as booked orders or near-term revenue.
intraday.source: Centum Electronics Limited, NSE/BSE Regulation 30 filing, 24 Nov 2026

swing.company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
swing.headline: Q2 and H1 FY27 unaudited results report strong year-on-year revenue and profit growth
swing.what_changed: The board approved unaudited standalone results for the quarter and half year ended 30 Sep 2026. Q2 revenue from operations was ₹161.96 crore versus ₹108.61 crore a year earlier; Q2 profit for the period was ₹15.76 crore versus ₹9.14 crore. H1 revenue was ₹263.40 crore versus ₹182.06 crore and H1 profit was ₹30.78 crore versus ₹16.64 crore. The filing includes the statutory auditor's limited-review report; the auditor noted that the comparative results for the corresponding prior-year period had been prepared by management and were not independently reviewed or audited.
swing.why_it_matters: Interpretation: the reported Q2 and H1 growth is a positive operating signal, but investors should assess margin durability, working-capital conversion and the post-IPO share base before extrapolating the growth rate.
swing.risk: Small-cap and recently listed-stock liquidity can amplify volatility. Results are unaudited; the auditor's review is not an audit opinion, and prior-year comparative figures were not reviewed. No forward guidance or price target is inferred.
swing.source: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited, NSE results filing and limited-review report, 24 Nov 2026

investing.headline: 25 November is the record date for the announced ₹600 crore tender-offer buyback
investing.what_changed: The board-approved buyback covers up to 6,59,34,065 equity shares, representing up to 6.86% of existing paid-up capital, at ₹91 per share for an aggregate amount up to ₹600 crore through the tender-offer route. The company fixed Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 as the record date for determining eligible shareholders. The filing states that promoters and promoter-group members intend not to participate; the detailed public announcement and process timelines were to follow.
investing.why_it_matters: Verified corporate-action fact: 25 Nov is the eligibility record date. The announced ₹91 is the buyback price, not a market-price target; actual participation and acceptance depend on the final offer documents and tender mechanics.
investing.risk: Eligibility depends on the record-date position and depository records. Final offer timelines, tender ratio, acceptance and settlement remain relevant; the buyback does not guarantee acceptance of all tendered shares.
investing.source: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited, NSE/BSE board-outcome filing, 12 Nov 2026
